key_insight: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization identified HiPIMS processes, including single-pulse modes, with deposition rates exceeding direct-current sputtering references.
engineering_relevance: Optimized pulse designs could increase thin-film manufacturing throughput while retaining a useful ionized flux.
method: Use multi-objective Bayesian optimization to explore pulse-packet process settings.
Jointly target high ionized flux fractions and deposition rates.
Evaluate more than 2,000 distinct sputtering processes.
evidence_signal: At 1.0 Pa, millisecond-scale pulses were ideal for moderate ionization fractions of 5–20%, and many sampled HiPIMS processes exceeded DC reference deposition rates.
watch_item: The proposed gas-rarefaction mechanism remains a hypothesis, and higher deposition rates alone do not establish equivalent film quality.
paper_title: Multi-objective Bayesian optimization reveals HiPIMS deposition rates exceeding direct current sputtering
